privacy: Amar Medical Agency respects your privacy and is committed to protecting the personal information you share through our website.
Depending on how you use our website, we may collect:
Contact information: Name and mobile number submitted through the appointment request form.
Appointment information: Your selected doctor and details you voluntarily provide through WhatsApp.
Communication information: Messages, questions, feedback or enquiries you send to us.
Technical information: Basic information that may be recorded by our website hosting provider when you access the website, such as IP address, browser type and access logs.
Please do not submit prescriptions, medical reports or other sensitive health information through general website forms unless specifically requested through an appropriate channel.
We may use the information you provide to:
Respond to appointment requests and enquiries.
Help coordinate consultations with the selected doctor.
Provide information about our pharmacy, products, opening hours and services.
Respond to feedback and improve our website and customer service.
Protect the website against misuse and comply with applicable legal obligations.
We do not promise that an appointment is confirmed merely because a form has been submitted or a WhatsApp message has been sent.

Our website may direct you to WhatsApp to communicate with Amar Medical Agency. When you use WhatsApp, your interaction is also subject to WhatsApp's own terms and privacy policy. Our website is hosted through Vercel. The hosting provider may process technical information necessary to deliver, maintain and secure the website. At the time of writing, we do not intentionally use website analytics or advertising-tracking tools. If these tools are introduced in the future, this policy will be updated as appropriate.

Your browser or hosting infrastructure may use essential technical mechanisms to deliver and secure the website. We do not intentionally use advertising cookies or analytics cookies at present. You can manage cookies through your browser settings. Blocking certain essential technologies may affect website functionality.

We do not sell your personal information. Information may be shared with service providers when necessary to operate the website, facilitate communications, respond to your request, protect our rights or comply with applicable law. We expect such sharing to be limited to the relevant purpose.

We take reasonable steps to protect the information we receive. However, no website, internet transmission or electronic storage system can be guaranteed to be completely secure. We retain information only for as long as reasonably necessary for the purpose for which it was collected, including applicable record-keeping and legal requirements.

Subject to applicable law, you may request access to, correction of or deletion of personal information you have shared with us. Some information may need to be retained where required by law or for legitimate record-keeping purposes. To submit a privacy-related request, contact us using the details below.

Our website is intended for general use by the public. If you submit information on behalf of a child, please ensure that you are their parent or legal guardian, or otherwise authorised to provide that information.

Our website may link to external websites or services. We are not responsible for their privacy practices, content or security. Please review their respective policies before sharing personal information.
We may update this Privacy Policy to reflect changes in our website, services or applicable legal requirements. The revised version will be published on this page with an updated date.
For privacy-related questions or requests, please contact us by phone or through our available WhatsApp contact option.

13. Doctor Availability, OPD Timings & Waiting Period

The doctor's consultation timings communicated through this website, WhatsApp, telephone, or any other channel are indicative and may be subject to change due to medical emergencies, unavoidable circumstances, professional commitments, or other unforeseen events. Patients are advised to allow for a possible waiting period of approximately 1.5 to 2 hours beyond the communicated time and plan their visit accordingly.

Patients must report to the reception and complete their registration upon arrival. For example, if a patient is asked to report at 1:00 PM but arrives at 3:00 PM or 4:00 PM without having registered their arrival earlier, the originally communicated time does not guarantee immediate consultation. The patient's actual arrival and registration time, the existing queue, and patients already waiting will be considered when managing the consultation sequence. Accordingly, the patient may need to wait for approximately 1.5 to 2 hours or longer, depending on the circumstances. Late-arriving patients cannot insist on priority over patients who have already reported and are waiting in the queue.

Patients are expected to maintain orderly conduct and cooperate with reception staff and other patients. Abusive behaviour, intimidation, threats, or disruption of clinic operations will not be tolerated. Amar Medical Agency and the concerned clinic reserve the right to adjust OPD schedules, manage queues, or reschedule consultations when reasonably necessary. Wherever practicable, patients will be informed of significant delays or cancellations.

By requesting an OPD appointment or visiting the clinic, patients acknowledge that the communicated consultation time is indicative and that waiting periods may occur. However, nothing in this clause limits any rights or remedies available to patients under applicable law. Concerns regarding delays, cancellations, or queue management may be raised with the reception or clinic management.
डॉक्टर की उपलब्धता, OPD का समय एवं प्रतीक्षा अवधि

इस वेबसाइट, WhatsApp, टेलीफोन या किसी अन्य माध्यम से बताई गई डॉक्टर की परामर्श संबंधी समय-सारणी अनुमानित है और चिकित्सा संबंधी आपात स्थिति, अपरिहार्य परिस्थितियों, व्यावसायिक प्रतिबद्धताओं या अन्य अप्रत्याशित कारणों से इसमें बदलाव हो सकता है। मरीजों से अनुरोध है कि बताए गए समय के अतिरिक्त लगभग डेढ़ से दो घंटे की संभावित प्रतीक्षा अवधि को ध्यान में रखकर अपनी यात्रा की योजना बनाएँ।

मरीजों को क्लिनिक पहुँचने पर रिसेप्शन पर अपनी उपस्थिति दर्ज करानी होगी और पंजीकरण कराना होगा। उदाहरण के लिए, यदि किसी मरीज को दोपहर 1:00 बजे आने के लिए कहा गया है, लेकिन वह पहले अपनी उपस्थिति दर्ज कराए बिना दोपहर 3:00 बजे या 4:00 बजे पहुँचता है, तो पहले बताया गया समय उसे तुरंत डॉक्टर को दिखाने की गारंटी नहीं देता। परामर्श का क्रम निर्धारित करते समय मरीज के वास्तविक आगमन एवं पंजीकरण के समय, उस समय की कतार और पहले से प्रतीक्षा कर रहे मरीजों को ध्यान में रखा जाएगा। इसलिए परिस्थितियों के अनुसार मरीज को लगभग डेढ़ से दो घंटे या उससे अधिक समय तक प्रतीक्षा करनी पड़ सकती है। देर से आने वाले मरीज पहले से उपस्थित एवं कतार में प्रतीक्षा कर रहे मरीजों से पहले दिखाने की ज़िद नहीं कर सकते।

सभी मरीजों से अपेक्षा है कि वे अनुशासन बनाए रखें तथा रिसेप्शन स्टाफ और अन्य मरीजों के साथ सहयोग करें। अभद्र व्यवहार, डराने-धमकाने, धमकी देने या क्लिनिक के कामकाज में बाधा डालने की अनुमति नहीं होगी। अमर मेडिकल एजेंसी एवं संबंधित क्लिनिक को उचित आवश्यकता होने पर OPD के समय में बदलाव करने, कतार का प्रबंधन करने या परामर्श को पुनर्निर्धारित करने का अधिकार होगा। जहाँ व्यावहारिक रूप से संभव होगा, मरीजों को महत्वपूर्ण देरी या परामर्श रद्द होने की सूचना दी जाएगी।

OPD के लिए समय पूछने, परामर्श हेतु पंजीकरण कराने या क्लिनिक आने पर मरीज यह समझते हैं कि बताया गया समय अनुमानित है और प्रतीक्षा करनी पड़ सकती है। हालाँकि, इस नियम की कोई भी बात लागू कानूनों के अंतर्गत मरीजों को प्राप्त अधिकारों या कानूनी उपायों को सीमित नहीं करती। देरी, परामर्श रद्द होने या कतार संबंधी समस्याओं के लिए मरीज रिसेप्शन या क्लिनिक प्रबंधन से संपर्क कर सकते हैं।
